definitions.gloss: friendship, social relations, association with friends
definitions.explanation: The act or state of associating with friends and acquaintances. Often used to describe the scope or nature of someone's social connections.

examples.japanese: {交友|こうゆう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
examples.english: He has a wide circle of friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交友|こうゆう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I value the friendships from my student days.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交友|こうゆう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{逆効果|ぎゃくこうか}→逆効果：14315_gyakukouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Interfering too much in a child's friendships can be counterproductive.

notes:
Most commonly appears in the compound {交友|こうゆう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (social relationships, circle of friends). Rarely used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交友|こうゆう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (circle of friends, social connections)
- {交友|こうゆう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (to have a wide social circle)
- {交友|こうゆう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ (to have a narrow social circle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交友|こうゆう}: friendship as social relations (somewhat formal)
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧: friendship as emotional bond
- ⟦{交際|こうさい}→交際：02800_kousai⟧: association, socializing (broader; also used for romantic relationships)
- ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧: association, socializing (everyday term)
